marks.gloss_en: ואזדא ריש לקיש לטעמיה: he transmits R' Chiya and his sons, לא נחלקו רבי דוסא וחכמים על מחצלות של אושא -- the dispute's chotzalot are mats

Reish Lakish: I am the atonement of R' Chiya and his sons -- when Torah was forgotten from Israel Ezra came up from Babylonia and founded it; again forgotten, Hillel the Babylonian; again, R' Chiya and his sons
אלא אמר רב פפא: in a small mat all agree undesignated is for lying; they dispute a large one (= p_pappa_ketana_kulei_alma, p_pappa_pligi_bigdola and his reports)
Rav Pappa: regarding a small mat everyone agrees that undesignated it is for lying
אמר ליה אביי: אי הכי, רבי אליעזר אומר אחת קטנה ואחת גדולה -- 'אחת גדולה ואחת קטנה' מיבעי ליה!
ועוד: כי פליגי בגדולה הוא דפליגי, ורבי אליעזר לחומרא -- דתניא: מחצלת הקנים גדולה מסככין בה; רבי אליעזר אומר: אם אינה מקבלת טומאה מסככין בה
the baraita: a large reed mat -- one roofs with it
ומאי עשאה לשכיבה דקאמר? -- if undesignated is already for lying, why does R' Eliezer say 'made it for lying'?
הכי קאמר: סתם עשייתה נמי לשכיבה, עד דעביד לסיכוך (= p_re_stam_asiya_lishchiva)
the stam's reading of R' Eliezer's 'made it for lying': the undesignated making of it is also for lying, until one makes it for roofing
מדרס אין, טמא מת לא? והא אנן תנן: כל המטמא מדרס מטמא טמא מת!
the mishna: whatever becomes impure with midras becomes impure with corpse impurity
Rava, reconstructing the mishna (large: undesignated is as if made for roofing; small: as if made for lying): R' Eliezer comes to say that small and large alike, undesignated, are fit for roofing
the baraita: a mat of shifa or of gemi, large -- one roofs with it
R' Yishmael son of R' Yosei in his father's name: this one and that one alike -- one roofs with it
R' Dosa: all chotzalot become impure with corpse impurity
what are chotzalot? Rav Avdimi bar Hamduri: marzovlei
